subject: [AMBER] CIC Annual Meeting during WiFo 2023, Sep 4-6 in Leipzig � Call for Papers

messages.author: Guessregen, Stefan /DE
messages.body:
Dear colleagues and friends,
As announced during the last �German Conference on Cheminformatics� (GCC) in May 2022 in Garmisch-Partenkirchen, the Executive Board decided to embed the next annual meeting into the largest congress of the GDCh, the �Wissenschaftsforum� (WiFo) 2023, Sep 4-6, 2023 in Leipzig, Germany (
https://www.wifo2023.de
<
https://www.wifo2023.de
>,
https://www.wifo2023.de/en

The CIC Annual Meeting will take place on Tue, Sep 5, 2023, covering the core topics of the CIC Division, ranging from quantum mechanics over molecular simulation quantum mechanics to artificial intelligence in drug discovery, chemistry, and material science. The meeting will be composed of three sessions, each of which will be introduced by invited speakers:
- Alain Vaucher (IBM Research, Switzerland)
- Antonia Mey (University of Edinburgh, UK)
- Thomas Fox (Boehringer-Ingelheim, Germany)
We are offering several slots for short contributed oral communications (12 min lecture plus 3 min discussion) within each session on Tue, Sep 5, and also encourage you to participate by submitting posters for the session on Mon, Sep 4. We will also celebrate year�s recipients of the CIC Award for Computational Chemistry.
Of further interest to the CIC community are two sessions featuring exciting talks on Mon, Sep 4:
�Robots in Chemistry� (jointly organized with the GDCh Division of Medicinal Chemistry, invited lectures only):
- Werngard Czechtizky (AstraZeneca, Sweden)
- Ildik� Terebesi, Carl-Helmut Coulon (INVITE, Germany)
- Ross King (University of Cambridge, UK)
�Research Data Infrastructure� (featuring NFDI consortia relevant to the CIC community, invited lectures only)
- Sonja Herres-Pawlis (RWTH Aachen, Germany - NFDI4Chem)
- Andreas F�rster (DECHEMA, Germany - NFDI4Cat)
- Claudia Draxl (HU Berlin, Germany - FAIRmat)
Please submit your abstracts<
https://www.wifo2023.de/en/abstracteinreichung
> for short communications (deadline March 2, 2023) and posters (deadline May 2, 2023). Please contact cic-wifo2023.go.gdch.de<
http://cic-wifo2023.go.gdch.de
> for further questions.
We will be happy to meet you again in 2023 in Leipzig! GCC will return in fall 2024.
On behalf of the CIC Executive Board � the program coordinators
Stefan G�ssregen & Stefan M. Kast
